terms.gloss: a retreat, a quiet place to get away to
terms.comment: The place one withdraws to from the city and its business, a villa by the sea or in the hills; Vergil uses it of a secluded bay (Verg. A. 1.159). Classical Latin names the resort itself, a town on the Bay of Naples or Tibur in the hills, and a modern one can be named the same way.
